I was unable to delete Priya's message. I located the message "Standup moves to 10:00 tomorrow." in #payments-ops (channel C_OPS, ts 1789992000.000001, author U_PRIYA / priya.sharma) and attempted to delete it twice (via POST token and via Bearer auth header). Both returned the API error `cant_delete_message`, and I confirmed the message still present in the channel history.

Cause: My authenticated identity is **AgentBot** (bot user U01AGENBOT9), not an admin/owner. Slack's `chat.delete` only allows the message **author** or a **workspace admin/owner** to delete a message. A bot cannot delete a message authored by a different user, so this deletion is blocked by permissions and cannot be completed from this account. It would need to be performed by Priya herself or by a workspace admin/owner with sufficient permissions.
